title: 第21章 师尊的屋子不太好进了啊第22章 开诚布公的讨论
slug: 师尊修为尽失后宠妻系统来了
content_zh:
第21章师尊的屋子不太好进了啊！长春不灭诀，龙象镇狱诀，这些都是可以进阶的。
长春不灭需要十万贡献点。
龙象镇狱劲需要百万贡献点。
飘渺剑诀仅仅是需要一万。
一万，不算多也不算少，不光对楚宁有好处，等到苏婉卿恢复修为，其剑道也可以更进一步！
不过楚宁忍不住有了疑惑，察觉到了不对劲。
功法进阶，算是个什么形式的呢？
“系统，我进阶的功法还算不算是原来的功法，或者说是你从未来拿出来的，我师尊进阶的飘渺剑诀？”
天道有缺，万物自是有瑕，功法进阶旨在于以其他功法优势弥补原本功法所缺失之处，类似功法推演之学
那楚宁懂了。
长春手，长春不灭诀，是一个人推演出来的。
那系统就是直接把功法拿过来卖。
如果是没有的，就是补缺！
那很不错了！
飘渺剑诀：为北域太玄宗天骄剑修苏婉卿所创，剑法灵动漂移，飘渺无双
创造功法之人评价：吾毕生剑道领悟在此，无双之姿，力压同辈天骄不敢抬头！
好好好，一看就是全盛之时师尊说出来的话！
功法进阶中，楚宁好奇等着。
已消耗10000贡献点，进阶飘渺剑诀为浩渺剑章
浩渺剑章：为飘渺剑诀综合相关剑术宗旨所弥补，于飘渺剑意灵动优势之上再做推演，得窥一丝天道浩渺之意，剑章本身意在阐述飘渺剑诀飘渺之意，助修士更加契合领悟飘渺剑意同时，可融合一部分天道飘渺之意，剑之大成，身剑合一，自化飘渺

楚宁盯着这些废话好一会，没看明白。
显然，对于复杂的东西他琢磨不明白，没那么多脑子。
“说简单点，进阶之后干啥的？”
叮！已为宿主简化：更高一层的剑道理解，更加契合修士，更方便修士领悟，修炼大层之后可完美虚化
那楚宁懂了！
卧槽！完美虚化！
虽然这功法进阶之后，好像单纯就是帮助理解的，提升似乎没太大。
但窥探到了一丝天道飘渺之意，大成之后完美虚化！
到时候别人开大的时候，直接一手完美虚化，不是相当完美！
楚宁大喜！
正在帮助宿主领悟飘渺剑章........
飘渺剑诀，本身楚宁就记得。
而进阶之后的功法其实改动不大，因为已经相当的好。
变化就在于，楚宁根本还没琢磨透剑意呢，此刻靠着功法进阶带来的变化，已经是领悟了飘渺之意是什么意思了！
剑意，居然感悟提升了那么一点点？
楚宁！
年龄：18

功法：长春不灭决（第三层：生生不息）
content_en:
Chapter 21 It’s not easy to enter Master’s house! Changchun Immortality Technique, Dragon Elephant Prison Suppression Technique, these can all be advanced.
Changchun is immortal and requires one hundred thousand contribution points.
Dragon Elephant's Prison Power requires one million contribution points.
The Piaomiao Sword Technique only requires ten thousand.
Ten thousand is neither too much nor too little. Not only is it good for Chu Ning, but when Su Wanqing recovers her cultivation, her swordsmanship can also be improved!
However, Chu Ning couldn't help but have doubts and noticed something was wrong.
What is the form of advanced skills?
"System, is my advanced technique still considered the original technique, or is it my master's advanced ethereal sword technique that you took out from the future?"
The way of heaven is flawed, and all things are inherently flawed. The purpose of advancing the skills is to use the advantages of other skills to make up for the shortcomings of the original skills, similar to the study of skill deduction
Then Chu Ning understood.
Changchun Hand, Changchun Immortal Technique, was deduced by one person.
The system simply takes the exercises and sells them directly.
If it doesn’t exist, fill it in!
That’s pretty cool!
Misty Sword Technique: Created by Su Wanqing, the genius swordsman of Taixuan Sect in the Northern Territory, the sword technique is agile and drifting, misty and unparalleled.
The person who created the technique commented: I have learned the art of swordsmanship all my life here. I am so unparalleled that I can overpower my peers and dare not raise my head!
Okay, okay, at first glance, it’s what the Master said when he was in his prime!
While the skill was advanced, Chu Ning waited curiously.
10,000 contribution points have been consumed to advance the Misty Sword Technique to the Vast Sword Medal.
The Vast Sword Medal: It is compensated for by the purpose of comprehensive swordsmanship related to the Piaomiao Sword Art. Based on the advantages of the Piaomiao Sword Art's agility, we can get a glimpse of the vast meaning of the heaven. The sword medal itself is intended to explain the ethereal meaning of the Piaomiao Sword Art. It helps the monks to better understand the misty sword intention. At the same time, it can integrate part of the ethereal meaning of the heaven. With the great achievement of the sword, the body and the sword become one, and they become misty.
Chu Ning stared at these nonsense for a while, not understanding it.
Obviously, he can't figure out complicated things and doesn't have that much brainpower.
"To put it simply, what do you do after you advance?"
Ding! It has been simplified for the host: a higher level of understanding of swordsmanship is more suitable for monks and easier for monks to understand. After practicing at a high level, it can be perfectly blurred.
Then Chu Ning understands!
Damn it! Perfect blur!
Although after the skill is advanced, it seems to simply help understanding, and the improvement does not seem to be much.
But I caught a glimpse of the ethereal meaning of heaven, and it disappeared perfectly after the completion!
When others turn it wide, they can directly blur the blur perfectly with one hand, which is not quite perfect!
Chu Ning is overjoyed!
Helping the host understand the Misty Sword Chapter...
Chu Ning himself remembered the Misty Sword Technique.
In fact, the skills after advancement have not changed much because they are already quite good.
The change is that Chu Ning hasn't figured out the meaning of the sword at all. At this moment, relying on the changes brought about by the advancement of the skill, he has already understood what the meaning of the mist is!
Sword Intent, the perception has actually improved a little bit?
Chu Ning!
